create.name: George Vithoulkas
create.bio:
George Vithoulkas was born in Athens in July 1932 and came to homeopathy by an unlikely route — trained as a civil engineer, he encountered the subject while working in South Africa and went on to study it formally in India, qualifying in 1966. He returned to Greece and spent the following decades doing something almost no one else was doing at the time: teaching classical homeopathy as a rigorous, systematic discipline, with live case-taking in front of students, in the manner of a teaching hospital.

He is the founder of the International Academy of Classical Homeopathy (IACH), established in 1995 on the small Sporadic island of Alonissos, where practitioners from around the world travel for on-site seminars. Since 2010 the Academy has also run a two-year e-learning programme now delivered in eleven languages. His writings — The Science of Homeopathy, A New Model for Health and Disease, the Essence of Materia Medica, and the ongoing multi-volume Materia Medica Viva — have been translated into 36 languages and remain standard reference works in homeopathy training worldwide.

His teaching centres on what he calls the "Levels of Health" model: a framework in which he proposes that a person's vitality can be graded, and that the practitioner's task is to read the direction a case is moving in rather than chase individual complaints. In 1996 he received the Right Livelihood Award (often called the "Alternative Nobel Prize") for, in the jury's words, his contribution to the revival of homeopathic knowledge and to training homeopaths to high standards. He holds honorary professorships at several universities in Eastern Europe and continues to direct the Academy and lecture at 94.

books.title: The Science of Homeopathy
books.author: George Vithoulkas
books.description: His foundational text, first published in 1980 and still the book most commonly put into the hands of new students. Vithoulkas sets out what he presents as the governing laws and principles of homeopathic practice, and his account of how a case should be taken, analysed and followed. Translated into dozens of languages and used as a course text worldwide.

books.title: The Essence of Materia Medica
books.author: George Vithoulkas
books.description: Rather than catalogue symptoms exhaustively, Vithoulkas tries here to capture the "essence" — the central character — of each major remedy as he understands it. It is the book practitioners tend to keep on the desk rather than the shelf, and it established the portrait-style approach that later teachers built on.

books.title: A New Model for Health and Disease
books.author: George Vithoulkas
books.description: Vithoulkas's attempt to give homeopathy a coherent theoretical frame, proposing a layered model of the organism in which he argues health and illness should be read as one continuum rather than as separate states. It is the conceptual groundwork for the Levels of Health teaching that now anchors his Academy's curriculum.

books.title: Levels of Health — Practical Applications and Cases (2nd Revised Edition)
books.author: George Vithoulkas
books.description: The working companion to his theory, built around annotated cases showing how he grades a patient's vitality and reads the direction a case is travelling in. Presented as the practical bridge between the model and the consulting room, and the text behind his Levels of Health postgraduate course.

books.title: Materia Medica Viva (multi-volume series)
books.author: George Vithoulkas
books.description: His life's reference project — an alphabetical materia medica planned at sixteen volumes, of which thirteen have so far been published. Each volume gathers provings, clinical observation and his own commentary on the remedies covered, and the series is widely treated as the most detailed modern materia medica in English.

books.title: Homoeopathy: Medicine of the New Man
books.author: George Vithoulkas
books.description: His 1979 introduction for the general reader — the book that brought his name to an English-speaking audience. Written as an accessible account of what he believes homeopathy is and why he thinks it matters, rather than as a practitioner's manual.

books.title: Homeopathy, Medicine for the New Millennium (29th Edition)
books.author: George Vithoulkas
books.description: A short, much-revised primer now in its 29th edition, published by his own Academy. It is his condensed statement of principles, written for newcomers and frequently used as the first reading on IACH courses.

books.title: Classical Homoeopathy
books.author: George Vithoulkas
books.description: A collected-teachings volume published in India drawing on his seminar material. It circulates widely in the Indian market and is often a student's first Vithoulkas text there.

books.title: The Bern Seminar
books.author: George Vithoulkas
books.description: A recent Academy-published record of one of his seminars, presenting the cases and commentary from those sessions in book form. One of the more current additions to his catalogue.

courses.title: 2-Year E-Learning Program in Classical Homeopathy
courses.description: The IACH's flagship qualification — 750 hours across two years, comprising roughly 300 hours of recorded video and audio from Vithoulkas's own teaching, 300 hours of study and 150 hours of clinical practice. Delivered in eleven languages, with live-case video, materia medica, repertorisation and his Levels of Health framework running through the curriculum.

courses.title: Levels of Health — Postgraduate Course
courses.description: A postgraduate module built around his central theoretical contribution, teaching practitioners how he grades vitality and reads case direction. Available in twelve languages including English, Spanish, Brazilian Portuguese, Russian, German, Arabic and Greek.

courses.title: Organon — Postgraduate Course
courses.description: A close reading of Hahnemann's Organon of the Medical Art as Vithoulkas interprets it, paragraph by paragraph. Offered in English, Spanish, Brazilian Portuguese, Romanian and Russian.

courses.title: New Horizons in Medicine — Postgraduate Course
courses.description: His broader argument about where he believes homeopathy sits in relation to contemporary medicine and research. Pitched at qualified practitioners and medical professionals; available in seven languages.

courses.title: Strategies in Prescribing — Postgraduate Course
courses.description: The most practical of the four postgraduate modules, concentrating on how he approaches difficult prescribing decisions and second prescriptions. Offered in English, Brazilian Portuguese, Russian, Romanian and Spanish.

courses.title: The Question of Miasms — Webinar by Prof. George Vithoulkas
courses.description: A live twelve-hour online seminar over two afternoons, in which Vithoulkas and six invited speakers present clinical cases and take questions. Run on Zoom with simultaneous translation into nine languages.

courses.title: Courses in Alonissos (on-site seminars)
courses.description: In-person seminars held at the Academy on the island of Alonissos, where students observe Vithoulkas taking and analysing live cases. The residential setting is part of the draw — practitioners travel from across the world for these sessions.

courses.title: 3-Year Practitioner Program for North America
courses.description: A regional practitioner pathway built on the IACH curriculum and delivered for the North American market, leading toward practitioner-level competence in his method.

courses.title: Vithoulkas Compass
courses.description: A subscription expert system built on his repertorisation logic, designed to support practitioners in case analysis. Sold as ongoing access rather than a one-off purchase.

courses.title: Vithoulkas App
courses.description: A mobile application giving access to his materia medica content, lectures and community features, marketed to students and practitioners as a portable companion to the Academy's teaching.

free_resources.title: Online Materia Medica
free_resources.description: A freely searchable reference library covering roughly 1,500 remedies, drawing on nine classical authors including Allen, Boericke, Kent, Clarke, Farrington, Dunham and Nash. Searchable by remedy or by author, with no login required.

free_resources.title: Organon of Hahnemann (full text)
free_resources.description: The founding text of homeopathy made openly available on the Academy's site, presented alongside Vithoulkas's own reading of it. A genuine primary source rather than a teaser.

free_resources.title: Clinical Cases archive
free_resources.description: An open archive of written-up cases from Vithoulkas and IACH practitioners, showing how a case is taken, analysed and followed over time in his framework. Useful study material for students working through the method.

free_resources.title: Scientific Papers archive
free_resources.description: A collected set of the research papers he has authored or co-authored, freely readable. Presented as his own contribution to the research literature around homeopathy.
